##  Disease management module :: **Fungal - Anthr acnose**
### Bacterial & Other Diseases
**Bacterial Diseases** : They can cause a variety of symptoms including cankers, leaf spots, overgrowths, scabs, wilts, and others
  * ![](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/cankerleavess.jpg)
  * ![Other](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/redrust1s.jpg)


**Others:** This disease attack can causes reduction in photosynthetic activity and defoliation of leaves thereby reducing the vitality of the host plant.
###  Fungal Diseases - Anthracnose
** Organism :_Colletotrichum gloeosporioides (Glomerella cingulata_**), 
**_Gloeosporium mangiferae_**
**Most important disease in Mango in states like,****Bihar, Punjab, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Kerala, UP, AP, Rajasthan and Karnataka**
#### **Anthracnose infection at various parts of mango**
Move mouse over the image to view more details:
  * [ ![Anthracnose\(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf1s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf1.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf1.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (_Colletotrichum gloeosporioides_) : **On tender leaves light to dark brown spots develop** The disease causes serious losses to young shoots, flowers and fruits under favorable climatic conditions. 
  * [ ![Anthracnose\(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf2s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf2.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf2.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (_Colletotrichum gloeosporioides_) : **On older spots, infected tissues falls off giving shot hole appearance**
  * [ ![Anthracnose \(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf3s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf3.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraleaf3.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (_Colletotrichum gloeosporioides_) : **The disease causes leaf spot, On tender leaves light to dark brown spots develop**


  * [ ![Anthracnose \(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthratwig4s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthratwig4.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthratwig4.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (_Colletotrichum gloeosporioides_) : **The disease causes the wither tip of young tender twigs.** It also results in die-back which appears as blackening of growing tips
  * [ ![Anthracnose \(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraciihr8s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraciihr8.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraciihr8.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides) : Anthracnose symptoms on leaves, The symptoms are most visible on leaves and ripe fruits. **The color of the infected part darkens as it ages.**
  * [ ![Anthracnose \(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrablossom5s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrablossom5.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrablossom5.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (_Colletotrichum gloeosporioides_) : **The disease results in blossom blight.****Infection starts from the blossoming period until the fruits are more than half grown**.**Panicles are infected**. Flowers and fruits under are affected by favorable climatic conditions (high humidity, frequent rains and the temperature range of 24- 32°C).


  * [ ![Anthracnose\(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrafruit6s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrafruit6.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrafruit6.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides) :**Green fruit infections remain latent until ripening.** At harvest can develop significant anthracnose symptoms rapidly upon ripening.
  * [ ![Anthracnose \(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrafruit7s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrafruit7.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthrafruit7.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
Anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides) : The disease causes serious losses to young fruits. **Prominant black spots are spreading throught out the fruit surface**.**Infection rapidly increases with dark brown to black spots expanding faster rate**
  * [ ![Anthracnose \(thumbnail\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraciihr9s.jpg)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraciihr9.jpg)![ Disease \(larger image\)](https://mango-crop.web.app/diseasemanage/anthra1/anthraciihr9.jpg) Symptoms and control !   
AAnthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides) :**Dark brown to black decay spots on fruit** s The disease causes serious losses to young shoots, flowers and fruits under favorable climatic conditions.


Move mouse over a thumbnail for a full sized version)
**Anthracnose**(_Colletotrichum gloeosporioides_) :: It is a serious disease on leaves and young shoots in rainy season and on fruits after harvest. The disease results in leaf spot, blossom blight, wither tip, twig blight and fruit rot symptoms. Young leaves when infected wither and dry up. At times when only the edges of the leaves are affected, their margins darken, dry up and may fall out, giving the leaf a ragged appearance. The disease causes the wither tip of young tender twigs. It also results in die-back which appears as blackening of growing tips.

<p class="auto-style4" style="width: 645px"><span class="auto-style5"><strong>Anthracnose
</strong>(<em>Colletotrichum gloeosporioides</em>) :</span><span><span class="auto-style5">: 
It is a serious disease on leaves and young shoots in rainy season and on fruits 
after harvest. The disease results in leaf spot, blossom blight, wither tip, 
twig blight and fruit rot symptoms. Young leaves when infected wither and dry 
up.  At times when only the edges of the leaves are affected, their margins 
darken, dry up and may fall out, giving the leaf a ragged appearance. The 
disease causes the wither tip of young tender twigs. It also results in die-back 
which appears as blackening of growing tips. </span></span> </p>
